Potaya
or Pota Bhaṭṭa of the Vādhūlagotra; son of Śiṅganārya an. Śiṅgāmbā; devotee of Umāmaheśvara; resident of Kākamrāni.
--Prasaṅgaratnāvali. anthology in 79 paddhatis. composed in 1466 A. D. MD. 12068.
Partly published in Sakalavidyābhivardhanī i. ii. iv. Vizagapatnam, 1892-7. See IO. 7231.
